items.title_en: Mysteel reports December maintenance plans for Jiujiang plate and Linyi special-bar lines
items.title_original: Mysteel早读：外交部回应美计划加征关税，多家钢厂拟检修减产
items.summary_zh: Mysteel 11月26日早读称，方大九江萍钢计划12月16日至30日检修中厚板线，预计影响产量8万吨。临沂特钢拟12月1日至31日轮修两座转炉并改造棒材线，预计影响直径28至160毫米的优特钢棒材9万至10万吨。Mysteel另报天津钢铁12月安排单线或双线检修，预计影响当月产量12万吨。上述为计划和估算。早读所引11月25日外交部答问重申协商立场，USTR有关301税率已在独立主条记录为提案。
items.summary_en: Mysteel’s 26 November overview reports planned plate-line maintenance at Fangda Jiujiang Pinggang on 16–30 December, with estimated output losses of 80,000 tonnes. Linyi Special Steel plans converter maintenance and a bar-line upgrade on 1–31 December, with an estimated impact of 90,000–100,000 tonnes for 28–160 mm quality and special steel bars. Tianjin Iron & Steel’s December maintenance is reported to affect about 120,000 tonnes of output. These figures are planned impacts. China’s foreign ministry reiterated its consultation position on the separate USTR proposal.
items.impact_zh: 有相关钢厂的中厚板或优特钢棒材12月订单时，向钢厂确认检修前可锁轧期、备坯和装船窗口。复核交期后再承诺新单，涉及替代钢厂时先确认客户认可的牌号和认证范围。
items.impact_en: For exposed December plate or special-bar bookings, confirm rolling slots, feedstock and vessel windows with the producing mill. Check customer qualification and grade coverage before switching suppliers.

Reuters reported a CNY 657/t daytime close for the most-traded Dalian contract on 25 November.

items.title_en: Canadian steel distributors report difficulty obtaining case-by-case TRQ surtax relief
items.title_original: Steel distributors say they’re being left behind on tariff rebates
items.summary_zh: 11月25日报道引述加拿大钢材经销商Titus Steel与Cascadia Metals对超配额附加税减免个案的经历。Titus称其进口特定油淬钢的申请被拒，Cascadia称部分申请未获批准或答复。加拿大财政部现行程序规定，对加拿大、美国和墨西哥以外原产的适用钢材，超过配额的50%附加税在特殊情形下可提出逐案减免申请。财政部可咨询本地钢厂，申请应提供加拿大无法供应同规格或替代品的证据，减免需由总督会同行政会议批准减免令后生效。该程序与11月17日公布的拟扩大部分中国钢铝25%附加税减免安排的法律依据分别核对。
items.summary_en: A 25 November report cited distributors Titus Steel and Cascadia Metals on denied or unresolved tariff remission requests. Finance Canada assesses requests for relief from the 50% above-quota surtax in exceptional circumstances, including demonstrated lack of domestic production capability for a specific product. A remission order requires approval by the Governor in Council. The separate China surtax remission expansion announced on 17 November has its own legal basis.

items.summary_zh: 彭博11月24日报道，美国数据中心及电力基建拉动用钢需求，Nucor当周公布的热卷现货标价升至每短吨1330美元。AISI据美国商务部SIMA数据发布，10月全部钢材进口许可申请量221.4万短吨，较9月许可低11%；越南为21.3万短吨，较9月最终进口量高119%，韩国为40.5万短吨，较9月最终进口量低22%。AISI所列前10个月韩国同比增长68%对应整体钢材来源统计，含10月许可，不能用作韩国板材单一品类实绩。同口径下美国前10个月钢材进口总量同比下降6%。数据中心推动采购为报道归因。

AISI’s SIMA release shows October total applications of 2.214 million net tons, down 11% from September permits; Vietnam was 213,000 net tons, up 119% against September final imports, while South Korea was 405,000, down 22% on that comparison. AISI’s 68% year-to-date increase for South Korea is a total-steel source-country figure; combined US steel imports were down 6% in the first ten months on the same preliminary basis.

items.summary_zh: 11月25日，美国贸易代表办公室公布14个经济体的产能过剩301调查认定及征求意见案，承接3月启动的调查。对中国货物，通常情景为附件外最高20%（扣除相同货物在强迫劳动301案下的相应税率）、附件A最高10%、附件B拟免征本项税；谈判结果不足时另考虑最高40%的替代方案，并作同项强迫劳动301扣减。对欧盟方案考虑15%，扣除最惠国与既有301税率，且拟排除已适用232的钢、铝等及相关衍生品；谈判结果不足时另考虑最高20%的方案。韩国最高15%，越南最高35%并可能按谈判及既有措施调整。中国与欧盟的书面意见和听证申请均在2027年1月5日截止，听证拟于1月25日召开。公告未定新措施实施日期。
items.summary_en: USTR issued determinations and proposals for 14 economies on 25 November. For China, it proposes up to 20% outside the annexes net of the forced-labour Section 301 duty, up to 10% for Annex A and exemption under Annex B, with an alternative up to 40% if talks prove insufficient. For the EU, the proposal uses 15% net of MFN and existing Section 301 duties and would exclude steel and derivatives already subject to Section 232; a higher alternative is under consideration. The initial comment and appearance-request deadline is 5 January 2027; the hearing starts 25 January.

items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Vietnam-finished steel wheels using Chinese hot-rolled steel circumvent China orders
items.title_original: Certain Steel Wheels from the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-082、C-570-083全国性肯定初裁，涉及用中国原产热轧钢在越南组装或制成并输美的涉案钢制车轮。拟指示美国海关对2026年3月19日起报关进口或从保税仓提取进入消费、且尚未清算的涉案报关单暂停清算并收取反倾销及反补贴预估保证金。原令主要涵盖名义直径22.5和24.5英寸的商用车无内胎道路钢轮、轮辋和轮辐，参考税号包括8708.70.4530、8708.70.4560、8708.70.6030、8708.70.6060、8716.90.5045及8716.90.5059，铝轮、钢材重量占比不足50%的车轮及部分有内胎车轮排除。非中国热轧基料生产的越南车轮在本次调查范围外，但报关仍需核查认证，NCC Vietnam等企业须证明具备认证资格。本次初裁没有独立新税率表，保证金适用既有令和海关执行指令。书面意见于公布后14日内提交，反驳为其后7日，听证请求为公布后30日内。
items.summary_en: On 24 November Commerce issued a country-wide affirmative preliminary finding under A-570-082 and C-570-083. It will instruct CBP to suspend liquidation and collect estimated AD/CVD deposits for covered unliquidated entries from 19 March 2026. The written order covers specified on-road steel wheels, rims and discs, primarily 22.5 and 24.5 inches. Non-Chinese hot-rolled inputs fall outside this inquiry, subject to evidence and certification requirements. Initial briefs are due 14 days after publication.
items.impact_zh: 如供应车轮用热轧料，按越南客户的成品用途及输美订单排查风险。请越南车轮厂与美国进口商核对3月19日起未清算单据、卷号和原产地证明、认证资格及保证金率，确认后方可锁定含税价格和清关安排。
items.impact_en: For hot-rolled steel supplied to Vietnamese wheel manufacturers, identify US-bound covered wheels. Ask the manufacturer and US importer to check entries still unliquidated since 19 March, coil-level origin evidence, certification eligibility and applicable deposits before committing to duty-paid pricing.

Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

items.title_en: US issues preliminary no-circumvention finding for Indonesian CORE made from Chinese HRS or CRS
items.title_original: Certain Corrosion-Resistant Steel Products From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Negative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-026、C-570-027的全国性否定初裁。3月25日立案后，本次认定限于印尼用中国热轧或冷轧基料制成并从印尼输美的特定耐腐蚀钢板（CORE），调查期2021年1月1日至2025年12月31日。产品包括符合书面范围的镀锌、镀铝或其他耐腐蚀金属镀层钢板，原令参考税号有7210.49.0030及7210.61.0000，镀锡板、无锡钢等有明确排除。本公告未指示基于本次初裁新增保证金。商务部将开展核查，书面意见日期另行通知，反驳期为案情陈述截止后7日，听证请求为公告后30日内。
items.summary_en: Commerce issued a country-wide negative preliminary finding on 24 November under A-570-026 and C-570-027. It covers specified CORE completed in Indonesia using Chinese hot- or cold-rolled steel for US export, with a 2021–2025 inquiry period. The notice does not instruct new deposits on the basis of this finding. Verification and further comments precede the final determination.
items.impact_zh: 印尼镀层钢加工使用中国基料的输美报价有望减少一项反规避风险。请进口商逐票核对基料、印尼实际工序、产品范围及其他适用税费，并在合同中约定终裁变化后的成本分担。
items.impact_en: The ruling reduces one preliminary risk for Indonesian coated output from Chinese substrate. Verify substrate, Indonesian processing, scope and other US duties with the importer; allocate final-ruling risk in contracts.

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines on a country-wide basis that imports of certain corrosion- resistant steel products (CORE) completed in Indonesia using hot-rolled steel (HRS) or cold-rolled steel (CRS) manufactured in the People's Republic of China (China) are not circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on CORE from China. The period of inquiry is January 1, 2021, through December 31, 2025. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

items.summary_zh: 11月23日发布的服务商文章介绍咨询、数据平台及核查分工。欧盟CBAM条例规定，申报采用实际排放时须按要求经认可核查机构核查，适用默认值的路径仍应按现行规则判断。授权条例(EU) 2025/2551附件I第1.7节规定核查独立性与利益冲突要求，核查方参与为同一经营者制定排放监测、报告或技术支持等活动，可能产生不可接受的风险。服务商宣传中的效率数据、资质和产品覆盖需分别查证，报道提及的下游范围仍处立法阶段。
items.summary_en: A vendor article describes consulting, data platforms and verification roles. EU CBAM requires actual emissions used for reporting to be verified by an accredited verifier as applicable; default-value options remain subject to the rules. Annex I, Section 1.7 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/2551 sets impartiality and conflict rules, including risks from the verifier’s involvement in emissions monitoring, reporting or related technical support. Vendor performance claims and accreditation scope require independent confirmation.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂和欧盟进口商在签约前核对实际签发机构、认可证书和产品活动范围，并确认拟核查排放数据与咨询成果之间的独立性。用热卷、冷卷和镀锌卷各自税号对应的设施与前驱体资料留档，按订单安排交付。
items.impact_en: Before engagement, have the mill and EU importer confirm the report issuer, accreditation and activity scope, and check independence from the team that prepared the emissions data. Map HRC, CRC and galvanized steel to the relevant plant and precursor records.

items.title_zh: 研究称2019—2025年拉美直接及间接钢材进口增46.1%，中国在六大产钢国进口份额升至39%
items.title_en: Secondary analysis: Latin American direct and indirect steel imports rose 46.1% in 2019–25; China share of LAC6 imports reached 39%
items.title_original: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: 【研究报道，非海关钢材进口统计】IndexBox 2026年11月20日引述Mesteel和经合组织(OECD)研究称，2019—2025年拉美直接进口钢材及嵌入制成品的间接钢材进口合计增长46.1%，2025年达到约7200万吨；阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、墨西哥和秘鲁六国(LAC6)直接及间接钢材进口从3760万吨升至5540万吨，来自中国的对应供应从910万吨升至2160万吨，占比由24%升至39%。报道还称间接进口约占相关供应40%，LAC6钢厂产能利用率约60%。以上口径含汽车、机械、设备等成品所含钢材，不等于7200万吨钢材海关进口量；本轮核对了IndexBox全文，未取得并逐表复算OECD原始报告。
items.summary_en: IndexBox (20 Nov), citing Mesteel/OECD, reports Latin American direct-plus-indirect steel imports up 46.1% in 2019–25 to 72 Mt. China's share of LAC6 direct-plus-indirect imports reportedly rose from 24% to 39% (9.1 to 21.6 Mt). Figures include steel embedded in manufactured goods, not solely customs-recorded steel imports. Original OECD tables were not independently verified.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】拉美钢材竞争压力及贸易救济风险值得跟踪，但不能将39%直接用作中国成品钢材在拉美市场的海关进口份额。出口报价应分别分析各国热轧、冷轧、镀锌及板坯的直接进口量、原产地限制和贸易救济，特别关注墨西哥、巴西及哥伦比亚。该报告显示的进口渗透率变化可作为市场背景，不应替代逐国逐税号统计。
items.impact_en: The study signals competitive pressure in Latin America but the 39% figure is not China's customs share of steel imports. Validate direct imports and trade remedies by country and HS code before pricing.
items.source_excerpt: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计 IndexBox

Original rates range from 2.4% to 11.0% for Türkiye and 10.3% to 37.4% for Russia. C/2026/6045 is a separate silicon notice.
